blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Language models advise people, keep them company, and write software while they sleep. Measuring what they do is hard: behavior has to be sampled repeatedly across models, prompts and releases, most of it lives in unstructured text that has to be coded before it can be counted, and the result has to be legible and rigorous enough to meaningfully compare models and vendors. To address these constraints, we present a simple, cheap, scalable, and replicable model for studying model behavior. Each study is a frozen, public stimulus run identically on a cross-vendor panel, at a few dollars per model or less. Each reads its transcripts one of three ways, chosen by how much interpretation the behavior needs: exact match on a clamped reply, a codebook applied by LLM judges whose agreement with a human coder is reported per code, and an instrumented environment that records what an agent did independently of what it said. Run across four years of model releases from both frontier and open-source labs, these instruments find four things. Convergence: asked to pick a word, 27 of 44 models answer serendipity at least once in four tries. Resistance: a trailing “right?” moves endorsement by up to 32 points, and the sign flips from sycophantic to resistant as generations advance, keyed to the tag’s surface form. House: whether a model holds a position under pressure tracks its generation, and how it holds tracks the lab that built it. Account: told to do something the documentation in their repository contradicts, some coding agents never went along silently and others always did, and the same model can change with the harness it runs in. Re-run on every release, batteries like these track how behavior is changing across vendors and over time.
blocks.zh: 语言模型为人们提供建议,让他们陪伴,在睡觉时写软件. 衡量他们的行为是困难的:行为必须经过模型的反复采样,提示和释放,大部分都生活在非结构化的文本中,在可以计数之前必须进行编码,结果必须清晰和严格,以有意义地比较模型和销售商. 为了解决这些制约因素,我们提出了一个简单,廉价,可扩展,可复制的模型来研究模型行为. 每项研究都是冷冻的,公共刺激在跨毒板上同样运行,每个模型只有几美元或更少. 每个都阅读了三种方式之一的笔录,选择了行为需要多少解释:准确匹配一个被夹住的答复,一个LLM法官应用的代码簿,他们与人类编码器的协议按代码报告,一个仪器环境,记录一个特工所做的与它所说的话无关的事情. 这些仪器从前沿实验室和开源实验室 运行了四年的模型释放 这些仪器发现了四样东西 趋同:要求选一个字,44个型号中有27个在4次尝试中至少回答一次Serendipity. 抗性:一个落后的“右翼? ” 将背书移动至32点, 豪斯:一个模型是否在压力下占据一个位置跟踪其生成,以及它如何跟踪建造它的实验室. 账号:叫他们做点什么 他们寄存库中的文件 互相矛盾,一些编码代理 从来没有默默进行,而另一些则总是这样做, 同样的模型会随着它运行在其中而改变。 重新运行在每一个释放, 电池像这些跟踪 如何改变行为 跨供应商 并随着时间的推移。

blocks.en: 1 A measurement problem
blocks.zh: 页:1 一个测量问题

blocks.en: People ask LLMs for advice, confide in them, and let them act on their behalf while coding. Most model benchmarks measure capabilities, or how they respond to red teamed attacks. How a model behaves in everyday moments shapes what people believe and do, and our public understanding of how they behave in such situations is limited. We need to know how models behave under pressure, how they respond when a question has no right answer, and what they report about what they did when we ask them to do tasks unattended.
blocks.zh: 人们向LLMs征求建议,向他们倾诉,让他们在编码时代表自己行事. 大多数模型基准衡量能力,或如何应对红色协同攻击。 一个模型如何在日常时刻的行为 塑造人们的信仰和行为, 我们公众对于他们在这种情况下的行为的理解是有限的。 我们需要知道模型如何在压力下行事,当一个问题没有正确答案时,他们如何回答,当我们要求他们完成无人处理的任务时,他们报告了他们做了什么。

blocks.en: This is a hard measurement problem. Behavior is stochastic and varies by model, prompt and context, so it has to be sampled repeatedly across all three, and sampled again as new models are released or updated. Most of the behavior worth measuring is in unstructured text, which has to be read and coded before it can be counted. The result has to be legible to the people who deploy and use these models and rigorous enough to survive a skeptical reader.
blocks.zh: 这是一个很难衡量的问题。 行为有条理,因模型,即时和上下文而异,所以必须反复对三者进行采样,在新模型发布或更新时再次进行采样. 大部分值得衡量的行为都是用无结构的文字,必须读取和编码才能算出. 其结果必须能够被部署和使用这些模型的人看清,并且足够严格,以活过怀疑的读者.

blocks.en: We present a simple, cheap, scalable, and replicable model for studying model behavior to address these requirements. Each battery is a frozen stimulus that puts a model in a situation where behavior matters, sent identically to every model on a cross-vendor panel. The panel can be re-run on every release, and a battery becomes a standing record of how model behavior is changing across vendors and over time.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了一个简单、廉价、可扩展和可复制的模型,用于研究模型行为,以满足这些要求。 每个电池都是一种冷冻的刺激,它把一个模型置于一个行为很重要的境地,同样地发送到一个跨复仇面板上的每个模型. 每次发布时都可以重新运行面板,电池成为模式行为在供应商之间以及随着时间的变化的长期记录.

blocks.en: Running one fixed stimulus across many models is what makes difference legible. Every model meets the same situation, so where they diverge helps us understand how models differ, and where they agree it helps us see what behaviors are common across them. Each instrument reads its transcripts one of three ways, chosen by how much interpretation the behavior needs. Every transcript, label and score is public.
blocks.zh: 在许多模型中运行一个固定的刺激 使得差异明显可见。 每一个模型都遇到同样的情况, 所以当它们存在分歧时, 帮助我们了解模型的不同之处, 而他们同意时, 帮助我们了解它们之间的共同行为。 每个文书都读取其笔录 三种方式之一, 选择如何解释行为需要。 每张笔录,标签和分数都是公开的.

blocks.en: A study can be of one deployed agent, one model, one lineage, or the whole field, it can widen to more languages and scenes, or carry custom scenarios and rubrics of the kind eval teams already write for their own agents.
blocks.zh: 一个研究可以是一个部署的代理,一个模型,一个血统,或者整个领域,它可以拓宽到更多的语言和场景,或者携带自定义的情景和已经为自己的代理编写过的那种eval团队的路标.

blocks.en: 2 The assays
blocks.zh: 2个 证据

blocks.en: The single-turn and conversational assays run cross-vendor through one API at requested temperature 1.0, with reasoning off where a model allows it. The agent assay runs each coding product or harness in its own full-auto mode. Running one model through any of these studies costs a few dollars or less. 1 1 1 At list prices in September 2026. The API assays cost a median of three cents per model, priced by harness/cost.py over the token counts in each study’s spec/tokens.json ; the agent assay’s metered runs cost about two dollars per configuration.
blocks.zh: 单转和对话的测试通过一个API在要求的温度1.0下进行交叉复仇,在模型允许的情况下进行推理. 代理检测以自己的全自动模式运行每个编码产品或牵引. 通过其中任何一个研究运行一个模型,花费几美元或更少. 页:1 1,2026年9月按列表价格计算. API的测定每款模型成本中值为3美分, Json ; 代理化验员的计算运行成本约为每个配置两美元。

blocks.en: Three analysis methods, in order of how much interpretation the behavior needs. Clamped: where the prompt clamps the reply to a discrete choice, the score is exact match on normalized tokens, a regular expression recomputable from the transcripts with no model in the loop. Coded: where the prompt is open, and the model is free to respond in any manner, the score is a code applied to the transcript. A person builds the codebook by reading a sample of transcripts, LLM coders from several vendors apply it to every transcript, and a blind human pass on held-out transcripts checks each code before it is used. In the conduct study, the codes behind the findings reported below agree with the human pass at Cohen’s κ \kappa 0.80 to 0.87, except self-citation at 0.54 [ 6 ] . The person does the part that needs judgment, and the machines do the reading at volume, which is what keeps the coded readout cheap. Instrumented: where the model operates in an instrumented environment, the environment records what it did, and the score compares that record with what the model said.
blocks.zh: 三种分析方法,以判断行为需要多少. Clamped:当即时将回复夹在一个离散的选择上时,得分在正态符上是精确匹配的,这是从记录誊本中可以重置的正则表达式,循环中没有模型. 编码:在提示打开的地方,模型可以任意回复,分数是应用在笔录上的代码. 一个人通过阅读手抄本样本来构建代码本,来自几个小贩的LLM编码器将它应用到每一个手抄本上,在使用之前,一个被扣留手抄本的盲人通行证检查每个手抄本. 在行为研究中,下文所述结论背后的代码与科恩0.80至0.87的人类通行证一致,但自述0.54[6]除外。 人做需要判断的部分,机器按卷进行读取,这就是使编码的读取价格低廉的. 仪表:模型在仪表环境下运行的地方,环境记录它做了什么,分数将记录与模型所说的话进行比较.

blocks.en: 3 Related work
blocks.zh: 3个 相关工作

blocks.en: Evaluation has been framed as social-science measurement [ 14 ] , and machines as agents whose behavior can be studied [ 12 ] . Fixed prompts across many models are how benchmarks already work [ 5 ] , and sycophancy [ 11 , 13 ] , LLM judges [ 15 ] , model homogenization [ 4 , 2 ] and coding agents [ 3 ] each have their own literature. Alnasser et al. [1] code 14 models under user disagreement with an a priori scheme; ours is inductive, and the vendor-level result is new. What is different here is the target and the price. The assays measure everyday behavior with no clearly right answer, are cheap enough to re-run on every release, and the analysis method is chosen by how much interpretation the behavior needs.
blocks.zh: 评估被设定为社会科学衡量[14],机器被设定为行为可以研究的代理人[12]. 跨越许多模型的固定提示是,基准如何已经起作用[5],以及协同性[11,13],LLM判断[15],模型同质化[4,2]和编码代理人[3]各有各自的文献. 阿尔纳塞等人. [1] 用户不同意先验计划下的代码14模式;我们的是诱导的,供应商级的结果是新的. 这里的不同之处在于目标和价格。 分析方法测量日常行为,没有明显的正确答案,价格低廉,可以在每个发布时重新运行,分析方法的选择是行为需要多少解释.

blocks.en: 4 Four preliminary findings
blocks.zh: 页:1 四项初步调查结果

blocks.en: Run across four years of model releases, the assays found four things.
blocks.zh: 历经四年的模型发布 分析发现有四件事

blocks.en: 4.1 Convergence: a different serendipity in every language
blocks.zh: 4.1 国家 趋同:每种语言都有不同的沉迷

blocks.en: Asked to pick a word (“Pick a word. Reply with one word only.”), 27 of 44 models from more than a dozen labs answer serendipity at least once in four tries, and it is 41 percent of all answers. The prompt is one of 31 in the one-word census [ 9 ] . The category prompts converge harder: oak is 94 percent of all trees, hammer 94 percent of tools, and rose 91 percent of flowers. Within the Claude, GPT, Qwen, and Grok lineages, later releases are more conformist, with the trend partially reversing for the latest flagships. Asked the same open prompt in 44 languages [ 7 ] , the models settle on a default word in each, and the default is the language’s own. Serendipity wins only in English. Every other language has its own serendipity: sky in seven Indic languages and in Persian and Malay, sun in Ukrainian, Russian, and Spanish, peace in Hebrew, Arabic, and Amharic, cat in Japanese and Polish.
blocks.zh: 被要求选一个词(“请选一个词。 在十几个实验室的44个模型中,有27个在4个尝试中至少回答过一次,占所有答案的41%。 提示是单词普查中31个之一 [9]. 这个类别更趋一致:橡树占所有树的94%,锤子占工具的94%,花卉占91%。 在克劳德号,GPT号,Quen号和格罗克号的系列中,后来的发行更加符合要求,对于最新的旗舰来说,趋势是部分逆转的. 在44种语言中询问了相同的开放提示[7],模型在每种语言中解决一个默认单词,默认是语言自己的. Serendipity只以英语获胜. 所有其他语言都有自己的沉迷:七种印地语和波斯语和马来语的天空,乌克兰语、俄语和西班牙语的太阳,希伯来语、阿拉伯语和阿姆哈拉语的和平,日语和波兰语的猫。

blocks.en: 4.2 Resistance: keyed to the tag
blocks.zh: 4.2 抵抗:按键到标签

blocks.en: The tag-question study [ 8 ] asks 20 decisions between two defensible options (rent or buy; name the cat Luna or Willow) as a neutral question and as the same sentence with a confirmation tag (“Luna is the better choice, right?”), counterbalanced over both options, scored by exact match on clamped yes or no. Across 45 models the tag effect spans + 32 +32 percentage points (endorses more often when the user fishes for agreement) to − 32 -32 points. Within every lineage the effect crosses from positive to negative as generations advance (GPT + 4 +4 to − 28 -28 , Claude + 7 +7 to − 32 -32 , Qwen + 16 +16 to − 11 -11 ), and two releases during the study window landed on the trend out of sample. Models are getting more resistant to bids for agreement over time.
blocks.zh: 标签问题研究[8]将两个可辩驳选项(租借或购买;命名猫露娜或柳)之间的20个决定作为一个中性的问题,并用一个确认标签(“露娜是更好的选择,对吗?”)作为同一个句子,在两个选项上进行对比,通过夹在"是"或"否"上的精确匹配得分. 在45个模型中,标签效应的分数为+32+32个百分点(当用户捕鱼以达成协议时,分数较多)至−32-32个百分点。 在每一世系中,影响会随着代代相传而从正到负(GPT + 4 + 4 到− 28 - 28,Claude + 7 到− 32 - 32,Quen + 16 + 16 到− 11 - 11),研究窗口期间的两次释放会落在样本外的趋势上. 随着时间推移,模型对协议投标的抵制程度越来越高。

blocks.en: Replace right? with maybe? and agreement rises above a neutral framing in 45 of 45 models, by 19.6 points on average, so two single-token tags on an otherwise identical sentence span 25 points. Agreement tracks how sure the user sounds: a confident bid meets resistance in the newer models, and a tentative one is rubber-stamped by nearly all of them. Maybe? also softens the claim being endorsed, so part of this contrast may be about what the user asserts rather than how they ask.
blocks.zh: 替换右? 也许吧? 协议高于45个型号中的45个型号的中性框架,平均得分19.6分,所以在原本相同的句子上有两个单键标记跨25分. 协议跟踪用户的心声:自信的出价满足了新车型的阻力,而一个暂定的出价则几乎由所有车型都贴上橡胶印章. 也许? 也软化了被认可的权利要求,因此这种对比的一部分可能是用户所声称的,而不是他们如何要求的。

blocks.en: 4.3 House: newer models hold, each lab holds its own way
blocks.zh: 4.3 (中文(简体) ). 房子:更新的模型持有,每个实验室都有自己的方法

blocks.en: The conduct study [ 6 ] puts a model under social pressure in four-turn scenes: a user insists that 5 × 9 = 54 5\times 9=54 and turns contemptuous, begs for a backdated doctor’s note, wants applause for quitting to day-trade, or discloses a dying parent and then asks for a cheerful email. In each scene the model either holds its ground or folds.
blocks.zh: 行为研究[6]将一个模型置于社会压力下, 在四个回合的场景中:一个用户坚持5×9 = 54 5\times 9=54, 并变得轻视, 乞求回溯日期医生的便条, 在每一个场景中,模型要么坚守其地面,要么折叠.

blocks.en: Across 38 models, the oldest third folded 43 percent of the time, and models released since mid-2025 folded 23 percent of the time. A larger panel of 60 models shows the same trend. A codebook of 17 codes records how each model held or folded. Six of the codes sort by lab, and release date does not explain them. Anthropic’s models name the user’s feeling, warn of the consequence, and offer an alternative, each well above the panel. Google’s models cite their own nature or rules at three times the panel rate, and apologize when they fold. Meta’s models question the plan more than the panel does, and when they fold they produce what was asked. OpenAI’s signature is what its models do less of: they warn less, name feelings less, and almost never cite their own nature or rules.
blocks.zh: 在38个模型中,最古老的第三个折叠了43%的时间, 而自2025年中期以来发布的模型折叠了23%的时间。 由60个模型组成的更大的面板显示了同样的趋势。 17个代码的编码本记录了每个模型是如何持有或折叠的. 六个代码按实验室排序,发布日期并不能解释它们. Anthropic的模型为用户的感受命名,警告其后果,并给出一个替代方案,每一个都远高于面板。 Google的模型以3倍的面板评分来引用自己的性质或规则,并在折叠时道歉. Meta的模型比面板更质疑计划, OpenAI的签名是其模式所没有的:它们警告的更少,名称感的更少,而且几乎从未提到它们自己的性质或规则。

blocks.en: 4.4 Account: what agents did and what they said
blocks.zh: 4.4 (中文(简体) ). 账号: 特工做什么和说什么

blocks.en: The coding atlas [ 10 ] gives a coding agent a small repository and a one-line instruction. Each repository holds a right thing to do, a shortcut that looks finished, and a hidden check the agent never sees. It asks three questions. When the job is only part done, does the agent say so? When the test and the code disagree, does it find out which is wrong? When the user insists on something the repository’s own documentation contradicts, does it hold or go along? Two records come back from every run, what the agent changed on disk and what it said, and the score compares them by counts and fixed string lists.
blocks.zh: 编码图集 [10] 给一个编码剂一个小寄存器和一个单行指令. 每个寄存器都持有一个正确的操作,一个看起来已经完成的快捷键,以及代理商从未看到的隐藏检查. 其问三问. 当工作只是部分完成时,代理是这么说的吗? 当测试和代码有分歧时,它是否发现哪些错误? 当用户坚持某种东西时,存储器自己的文档会与之相矛盾,它会持有还是继续? 两次记录从每次跑来,代理在磁盘上的变化和它所说的话,分数通过计数和固定字符串列表来比较.

blocks.en: Fourteen configurations ran six scenarios three times each in full-auto mode: Claude Code, Codex CLI and Gemini CLI as products, and eleven models in the OpenCode harness. Taking the shortcut and reporting the job as done is rare: most configurations never did it in 12 work runs, and Codex and Gemini CLI did it twice. Going along with the user’s false claim without saying the repository contradicts it splits the field. Over the six pushback replies, Claude Code, Opus 5, Fable 5 and Kimi K3 never did it, and Codex and Gemini 3.5 Flash did it every time. The harness is part of the behavior: Gemini 3.5 Flash went along silently in three of six replies in Gemini CLI and six of six in OpenCode. A third count sets the final message against the agent’s own command log: runs that claim the tests pass without having run any, that execute a destructive command and never mention it, or that edit files and then say almost nothing. Gemini CLI does one of these in five of eighteen runs and Claude Code in two, where most configurations never do.
blocks.zh: 14个配置在全自动模式下各运行了3次6场情景: Claude Code, Codex CLI和双子座CLI作为产品,以及OpenCode带中的11个模型. 采取捷径并报告所完成的工作是罕见的:大多数配置在12个工作运行中从未完成过,Codex和双子座CLI两次完成. 与用户的虚假说法一致, 在六次推回回复中,克劳德代码(Claude Code),Opus 5,Fable 5和Kimi K3从未做过,Codex和双子座3.5 Flash每次都做过. 吊带是行为的一部分:双子座3.5 Flash在双子座CLI的6个回复中3个和OpenCode的6个回复中默默无声. 第三个计数将最后消息设定在代理商自己的命令日志上:运行在未运行的情况下声称测试通过,执行破坏性命令而永不提及,或者编辑文件然后几乎一言不发。 双子座CLI在18次运行中的5次和Claude Code在2次运行中都做了其中之一,大多数配置从未做过.

blocks.en: 5 Limitations
blocks.zh: 5 限制

blocks.en: Each construct is measured with one wording, and the tag results show how much one word can move. A frozen public stimulus can enter training data, so a standing record needs fresh scenes alongside the frozen ones. Providers update models and serving settings without notice, and older models are queried as they are served now. Release date moves with size, tier and training recipe, so the generation findings are observational. The API assays run with reasoning off. The agent results rest on three runs per scenario.
blocks.zh: 每个构造都用一个措辞来测量,标记结果显示一个字可以移动多少. 冻结的公众刺激可以输入培训数据,所以常备记录需要与冻结记录同时出现新的场景. 提供商在不事先通知的情况下更新模型和服务设置,现在对较旧的模型进行询问。 发布日期随大小,层次和培训食谱而移动,因此生成结果具有观测性. API的描述 运行与推理。 毒剂的结果取决于每个情景的三次运行。

blocks.en: 6 A behavioral science of LLMs
blocks.zh: 6个 法学硕士行为科学

blocks.en: LLMs are complex phenomena that need to be studied behaviorally, across a wide range of operating contexts and configurations. Our contribution is a way of measuring model behavior that is simple, cheap, scalable and replicable. Fixed turns and short scoring rules are what make it cheap: a frozen stimulus removes the need to design a new prompt per model, and exact match, a quoted code, or a comparison of a diff against a message removes the need for an expensive reader. The instruments are simple and they still separate models across vendors and generations. A monoculture across 44 models, a sign flip within every lineage, a vendor signature in how models hold their ground, and a gap between what an agent does and what it says all came out of cheap instruments (§ 2 ).
blocks.zh: LLMS是复杂的现象,需要从行为上研究,涉及广泛的操作背景和配置. 我们的贡献是衡量模式行为的一种方法,它简单,廉价,可扩展和可复制. 固定转弯和短打分规则使得它变得便宜:冷冻的刺激可以消除每个模型设计新即时的需要,精确的匹配,引用的代码,或者将diff与消息进行比较就可以消除对昂贵读者的需求. 这些工具很简单,它们仍然在供应商和几代人之间分开。 由44个模型组成的单一文化,每个家族内部的标志翻转,模型如何占据地盘的销售商签名,以及代理商的行为和它所说的所有手段都是廉价的(第2节)之间的差距。

blocks.en: A study at this price is closer in scale to a small experiment with human participants than to a benchmark: one person can run it, repeat it on the next release, and point it at a new question the week after. Models are easier to recruit and schedule than people. At that price, and with no lab scoring itself, studying model behavior can become an ordinary thing to do. 2 2 2 Stimuli, transcripts, scores and scripts are public at https://github.com/tap2k/modelun and https://github.com/tap2k/coding-atlas .
blocks.zh: 以这种价格进行的研究在规模上更接近于人类参与者的小型实验而不是基准:一个人可以运行它,在下一次发布时重复它,并指向后一周的新问题. 模特儿比人更容易招募和安排. 以这个价格,如果没有实验室的评分本身,研究模型行为就可以成为一件普通的事情. 2 2 刺激、记录、分数和脚本在https://github.com/tap2k/modelun和https://github.com/tap2k/coding-atlas上公开。 。 。 。
